name: decide-evaluation-contract-v1-3-1
title: Decide evaluation-contract v1.3.1
description: Record a separate operator accept, reject, or stop decision after immutable machine assurance.
creator: claude
notes: Inactive until committed machine assurance and a new explicit operator instruction.

dependencies: Authenticated committed B131-1 assurance evidence with verdict pass or fail
meta.activationGate: Authenticated committed B131-1 pass or fail and genuine operator response
meta.acceptanceGate: accept-with-rationale requires verdict exactly pass; reject-with-rationale or stop may follow pass or fail
meta.stopGate: No operator response, missing or mismatched assurance identity, ambiguous response, non-pass acceptance, or any implied technical authority
